description: Submit a multi-component LLM compile + link job via Qualcomm AI Hub. Returns a compile_job_id; poll with edgegate_check_llm_compile_status. Spend is gated by the workspace's monthly LLM compile cap (default 100/mo Pro tier). Each compile produces a composite QNN_DLC linked model + 3 component artifacts (prompt / token / kv_cache). Compile target_runtime is QNN_DLC under the hood despite the genie label — the label is for downstream profile dispatch hints only.
name: edgegate_llm_compile
